results.title: DPM Fadillah recovering well after successful heart bypass surgery
results.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Deputy Prime Minister Datuk Seri Fadillah Yusof, who is also Energy Transition and Water Transformation Minister, is recovering well after undergoing successful double coronary artery bypass surgery at the National Heart Institute (IJN) on Wednesday (Aug 12).
